about: [O1 after the critic] the first seconds of a drive (E, W 7 s on Grand Ave): every frame over 34 ms with what changed in it (programs compiled, geometries, textures, chunks built, the stream's ms).

steps.eval: (() => { const R = window.__hr; const slow = R.frames.filter((f) => f.dt > 34); return JSON.stringify({ n: R.frames.length, over50: R.frames.filter((f) => f.dt > 50).length, marks: R.mark, slow }); })()
